The '''''Twilight Star''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that operated around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point after the succession of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ''Twilight Star'' and a number of other starships queued above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], waiting for permission to depart from the world.
